prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1031; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of lower back pain and stiffness. The reported severity of the injury is notable given how light the impact appeared, and this mismatch was considered at intake. Over the course of 28 visits, care followed a conventional path of manual therapy, guided exercise, and a home stretching program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was gradually reduced as function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly support a lumbar strain. The patient reports no prior injury to the lumbar region, and no earlier treatment for this area is known to our records. Two billing entries for similar services recorded on the same day are currently under review by our office and will be reconciled separately. The patient was discharged to self-management with return precautions.
